name: SEC API (sec-api.io)
summary: SEC EDGAR filings as JSON from sec-api.io: filing search, full-text search, insider trades (Forms 3/4/5), 13F institutional holdings, XBRL-to-JSON financials, filing section extraction and ticker/CIK/CUSIP mapping.

api_key.description: a sec-api.io API key (from your sec-api.io user profile)

notes: The key goes in the Authorization header as-is, with no Bearer prefix (or as ?token=).
Search endpoints are POSTs with a JSON body {query, from, size, sort}; query is Lucene syntax over the documented fields of each dataset.

endpoints.name: Search filings
endpoints.summary: Filing metadata (form type, company, tickers, filedAt, links, data files) for EDGAR filings of any form type.

query.description: Lucene-syntax query over filing fields, field:value with AND/OR/NOT, wildcards and [a TO b] ranges.

from.description: Offset of the first result; default 0, at most 10000.

size.description: Results per call; default 50, at most 50.

notes: A read over POST. At most 10,000 results per query: page by raising from by size, and split larger sets into filedAt or periodOfReport date ranges.

endpoints.name: Full-text search filings
endpoints.summary: Search the text of filings and exhibits.

query.description: Words or quoted phrases, ANDed by default; supports OR, NOT/-, and * wildcards.

formTypes.description: Form types to include, e.g. ["8-K", "10-Q"]; default all.

ciks.description: Filer CIKs as strings; leading zeros optional; default all.

page.description: Page number as a string, from "1"; 100 results per page, at most page 100.

notes: A read over POST. The default window is only the last 30 days; set startDate for older filings.
When total.relation is gte the match count exceeds 10,000; narrow dates or CIKs.

endpoints.name: Search insider trades
endpoints.summary: Forms 3, 4 and 5 as structured JSON: issuer, reporting owner, relationship and each transaction.

query.description: Lucene-syntax query over filing fields, field:value with AND/OR/NOT, wildcards and [a TO b] ranges.

from.description: Offset of the first result; default 0, at most 10000.

size.description: Results per call; default 50, at most 50.

notes: A read over POST. At most 10,000 results per query: page by raising from by size, and split larger sets into filedAt or periodOfReport date ranges.
Transaction codes: nonDerivativeTable.transactions.coding.code:P is an open-market purchase, S a sale.

endpoints.name: Search 13F holdings
endpoints.summary: Institutional managers' 13F holdings per filing, searchable by manager CIK, holding ticker, CUSIP or put/call.

query.description: Lucene-syntax query over filing fields, field:value with AND/OR/NOT, wildcards and [a TO b] ranges.

from.description: Offset of the first result; default 0, at most 10000.

size.description: Results per call; default 50, at most 50.

notes: A read over POST. At most 10,000 results per query: page by raising from by size, and split larger sets into filedAt or periodOfReport date ranges.
Find who holds a stock with holdings.ticker:TSLA or holdings.cusip:<cusip>.

endpoints.name: Search 13F cover pages
endpoints.summary: 13F filing cover pages, searchable by fields such as crdNumber.

query.description: Lucene-syntax query over filing fields, field:value with AND/OR/NOT, wildcards and [a TO b] ranges.

from.description: Offset of the first result; default 0, at most 10000.

size.description: Results per call; default 50, at most 50.

notes: A read over POST. At most 10,000 results per query: page by raising from by size, and split larger sets into filedAt or periodOfReport date ranges.

endpoints.name: Convert a filing's XBRL to JSON
endpoints.summary: The XBRL financial data of one filing (e.g. a 10-K or 10-Q) as JSON.

htm-url.description: URL of the filing (.htm/.html) or its index page.

xbrl-url.description: URL of the XBRL instance .xml (from dataFiles in filings.search).

notes: Pass exactly one of htm-url, xbrl-url or accession-no.

endpoints.name: Extract a filing section
endpoints.summary: The text or HTML of one item (e.g. 1A Risk Factors, 7 MD&A) of a 10-K, 10-Q or 8-K.

item.description: One item. 10-K: 1, 1A, 1B, 1C, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 7A, 8, 9, 9A, 9B, 10-15. 10-Q: part1item1-part1item4, part2item1, part2item1a, part2item2-part2item6. 8-K: e.g. 1-1, 2-2, 5-2, signature.

endpoints.name: Resolve a ticker
endpoints.summary: Company name, CIK, CUSIP, exchange, sector and industry for a ticker.

endpoints.name: Find companies by name
endpoints.summary: Companies whose name matches, with ticker, CIK and CUSIP.

endpoints.name: Resolve a CIK
endpoints.summary: Tickers and company details registered under a CIK.
